items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a popular geography YouTube Shorts channel. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: brisk and curious, with natural emphasis and a short comic pause before each punchline. Chars voices funny cartoon characters, short and punchy.
lines: If you visit Roswell for its nineteen forty-seven U-F-O crash... you're nearly one hundred kilometres off.
So how did Roswell get the aliens?
Near a tiny village called Corona, rancher Mac Brazel finds junk all over his land.
[grumpy old cowboy, slow dry drawl] Looks like a kite exploded.
He reports it to the sheriff... in Roswell.
So how did Roswell steal it?
Roswell had an air base. Home of the world's only atomic bomber unit.
On July eighth, the base says it's captured a flying disc.
The local paper puts it on a ranch... in Roswell Region.
Within a day, the army says: weather balloon.
In nineteen ninety-four, the Air Force said it was Project Moh-gul.
Secret balloons from Ala-mo-gor-do, with microphones to hear Soviet atomic tests.
[deadpan secret agent, low and flat] I was spying. Not visiting.
Then in nineteen seventy-eight, a former Roswell officer called it a cover-up. And the legend landed.
Today, around ninety thousand people visit Roswell every year.
Whatever crashed... it never landed in Roswell. The tourists did.
[grumpy old cowboy, slow dry drawl] It landed on me. Where's my museum?
This is Bhoogol. Follow for more Geography Fun Facts.
